triage.summary: Tom Becker reports that QuickFit Gyms' website chatbot has shown "Something went wrong" for every message since this morning. He asks for immediate help because a promotion is running today and customers are complaining on Instagram.

task.title: Investigate and restore QuickFit Gyms' chatbot
task.description: Tom Becker (tom@quickfit-gyms.com) asks for immediate help with the QuickFit Gyms website chatbot, which has returned "Something went wrong" for every message since the morning of October 12. Investigate and resolve the outage; a major promotion is running today and customers are complaining on Instagram.

reply.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for flagging this. I understand the chatbot is failing for every message during today's promo. [Confirm when you can investigate and provide the next update.]

Alex
